title: HiRAE: Hierarchical Representation Autoencoding with Residual Budgets
title_zh: HiRAE: 层次表示自编码器

paragraphs.en: Pretrained visual representations support image generation, but may not fully preserve the fine-grained details needed for faithful reconstruction. Meanwhile, intermediate encoder layers contain complementary visual details, but learning to fuse them for reconstruction can produce a latent distribution that is difficult to model. Existing fusion methods require empirical tuning of layer selection or staged optimization of fusion and decoding, increasing configuration effort or training complexity. We introduce HiRAE (Hierarchical Representation Autoencoder), which learns a hierarchical fusion framework over the full encoder hierarchy to improve reconstruction fidelity while maintaining compatibility with generative modeling. HiRAE groups encoder layers by depth and learns residual corrections to the deepest representation. Group-wise norm caps bound these corrections relative to the deep anchor, with tighter budgets for shallower groups. Our HiRAE-24 preserves the latent token count and channel dimension. On ImageNet-256, HiRAE-24 reduces reconstruction FID from 0.299 to 0.209 relative to RAEv2 while maintaining competitive guided generation quality. For text-to-image generation, HiRAE-24 improves alignment over RAEv2 on GenEval, DPG-Bench, and GenAI-Bench both before and after supervised fine-tuning. Under the same generator-training and evaluation protocol, post-fine-tuning GenEval increases from 84.86 to 87.70.
paragraphs.zh: 预训练的视觉表示支持图像生成，但可能无法完全保留忠实重建所需的精细细节。 与此同时，中间编码器层包含互补的视觉细节，但学习将其融合以进行重建可能会产生难以建模的潜在分布。 现有的融合方法需要对层的选择进行经验性调整，或对融合和解码进行分阶段优化，从而增加了配置工作量或训练复杂性。 我们提出了 HiRAE（层次化表示自编码器），它通过在整个编码器层次结构中学习一种层次化融合框架，在保持与生成建模兼容性的同时提升重建保真度。 HiRAE 按深度对编码器层进行分组，并学习对最深层表示的残差修正。 组内范数上限将这些修正限制在相对于深层锚点的范围内，而较浅分组的预算则更为严格。 我们的 HiRAE-24 保留了潜在标记的数量和通道维度。 在 ImageNet-256 上，HiRAE-24 相较于 RAEv2 将重建 FID 从 0.299 降低至 0.209，同时保持了具有竞争力的引导生成质量。 在文本到图像生成方面，HiRAE-24 在 GenEval、DPG-Bench 和 GenAI-Bench 上的对齐效果优于 RAEv2，无论是在监督微调之前还是之后。 在相同的生成器训练与评估协议下，微调后的 GenEval 分数从 84.86 提升至 87.70。
